name: smwmusic-china-warrior-focused-spirit-main-bgm-remix
title: China Warrior - Focused Spirit ~ Main BGM (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of the Main BGM from China Warrior (aka The Kung Fu in Japan) for the TurboGrafx-16 / PC-Engine. Yeah, a game where you play as knock-off Bruce Lee and beat up some nuns has a banger OST (even though it's like 3 full songs and a couple jingles). Ended up playing this on my TurboGrafx-16 Mini back in December and fell in love with this theme.

I actually did start this port way back in April before getting too caught up on other songs. Luckily, I was able to get it finished now, and thank god I did. This song deserves some love, even if you don't ever plan on ever playing the game.

This is pretty lengthy song and also a great fit for auto-scrollers.

Important:
There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
3. B Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
